mapper.select: select from market_order where status in ( 'ESCROW_PENDING', 'ESCROW_CANCEL_PENDING', 'RELEASE_PENDING', 'REFUND_PENDING', 'DISPUTE_RELEASE_PENDING', 'DISPUTE_REFUND_PENDING' ) and (wallet_recovery_next_attempt_at is null or wallet_recovery_next_attempt_at <= current_timestamp) and ( not exists ( select 1 from market_wallet_action a where a.order_id = market_order.order_id and a.action_type = case when market_order.status in ('ESCROW_PENDING', 'ESCROW_CANCEL_PENDING') then 'ESCROW' when market_order.status in ('RELEASE_PENDING', 'DISPUTE_RELEASE_PENDING') then 'RELEASE' else 'REFUND' end ) or exists ( select 1 from market_wallet_action a where a.order_id = market_order.order_id and a.action_type = case when market_order.status in ('ESCROW_PENDING', 'ESCROW_CANCEL_PENDING') then 'ESCROW' when market_order.status in ('RELEASE_PENDING', 'DISPUTE_RELEASE_PENDING') then 'RELEASE' else 'REFUND' end and (a.next_retry_at is null or a.next_retry_at <= current_timestamp) and ( (a.wallet_txn_id is not null and a.status != 'PROCESSING') or ( a.wallet_txn_id is null and a.status = 'FAILED' and a.action_type in ('RELEASE', 'REFUND') and a.failure_code in ('17004', '17005') ) or ( market_order.status = 'ESCROW_CANCEL_PENDING' and a.action_type = 'ESCROW' and a.status = 'CANCELLED' and a.result_type = 'NOOP' ) ) ) ) order by coalesce(wallet_recovery_next_attempt_at, update_time) asc, order_id asc limit #{limit}
